description:
The ZNH-17SR low step-thru electric bike is a comfortable Class 2 commuter ebike for adults aged 18+. Built with a convenient low step-thru frame, it is perfect for riders who want easy mounting and dismounting, especially popular for women city riders. The top speed is limited to 20 MPH, following Class 2 ebike standards.

Powered by a 750W peak high-torque brushless motor and a 48V 13Ah (624Wh) removable lithium-ion battery, this ebike can reach up to 70 miles per charge. It only takes 4–6 hours to fully charge. The battery supports IPX4 waterproof protection for riding in light rain, and the removable design allows you to charge it indoors conveniently.

Equipped with a front suspension fork and 26-inch puncture-resistant anti-slip tires, it buffers bumps on city roads and paved paths. The frame supports a maximum load of 330 LBS and fits riders from 5'2" to 6'5".

This ebike arrives 85% pre-assembled. It comes with all necessary accessories: battery, charger, headlight, mirrors, mudguards, tool kit and user manual. You can finish assembly quickly and start your city commute, campus trip or casual leisure ride.

📌 Important Safety & Disclaimer
This is a Class 2 ebike that meets federal e-bike standards. Local traffic and ebike regulations vary by state and county. Please check your local laws before riding.
Always wear a properly fitted certified helmet while riding.
Riding range is affected by rider weight, load, terrain and speed.
